args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD
local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation
a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Premium') task.wait(.25)
local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local h=s.ShopHeader local f=s.ShopFooter
local function rect(x) return {x.AbsolutePosition.X,x.AbsolutePosition.Y,x.AbsoluteSize.X,x.AbsoluteSize.Y} end
local function inside(a,b) return a.AbsolutePosition.X>=b.AbsolutePosition.X-1 and a.AbsolutePosition.Y>=b.AbsolutePosition.Y-1 and a.AbsolutePosition.X+a.AbsoluteSize.X<=b.AbsolutePosition.X+b.AbsoluteSize.X+1 and a.AbsolutePosition.Y+a.AbsoluteSize.Y<=b.AbsolutePosition.Y+b.AbsoluteSize.Y+1 end
local function shown(x) while x and x~=g do if x:IsA('GuiObject') and not x.Visible then return false end x=x.Parent end return x==g end
local tabs=0 for _,x in ipairs(s.ShopTabs:GetChildren()) do if x:IsA('TextButton') then tabs+=1 end end
local tabNames=true for _,name in ipairs({'Fists','Premium','Boosts','Honor','Robux'}) do tabNames=tabNames and s.ShopTabs:FindFirstChild(name..'ShopTab')~=nil end
local allTextFits=true local bad={} local badCount=0
for _,x in ipairs(s:GetDescendants()) do
 if (x:IsA('TextLabel') or x:IsA('TextButton')) and x.Visible then
  allTextFits=allTextFits and x.TextFits
  if not x.TextFits then badCount+=1 if #bad<6 then bad[#bad+1]={name=x.Parent.Name..'.'..x.Name,text=x.Text,rect=rect(x),bounds={x.TextBounds.X,x.TextBounds.Y},textSize=x.TextSize,scaled=x.TextScaled,wrapped=x.TextWrapped,shown=shown(x)} end end
 end
end
local chrome=h.Title.Text=='SHOP' and h:FindFirstChild('Subtitle') and h:FindFirstChild('HeaderRedRail') and h:FindFirstChild('HeaderCyanRail') and h:FindFirstChild('CloseShop') and f:FindFirstChild('CloseShopBottom')==nil and f:FindFirstChild('SecureLabel') and f:FindFirstChild('ServerLabel') and s.ShopTabs.PremiumShopTab:FindFirstChild('SelectedRail')
local safe=g:WaitForChild('PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD')
local safeBounds=inside(g.GameMenu,safe)
local result={ok=not not chrome and tabs==5 and tabNames and allTextFits and safeBounds,chrome=not not chrome,tabs=tabs,tabNames=tabNames,allTextFits=allTextFits,safeBounds=safeBounds,badCount=badCount,bad=bad,viewport={workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X,workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y},safe=rect(safe),menu=rect(g.GameMenu),layout=s:GetAttribute('ShopCompactLayout')}
return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: full semantic typography fits and modal stays inside actual safe viewport

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation
local saved=H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.SettingsJSON.Value).uiScale
assert(type(saved)=='number','original authoritative UI scale missing')
local function observeScale(value)
 local snapshot=a:Invoke('Snapshot')
 local authority=H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.SettingsJSON.Value).uiScale
 return type(snapshot)=='table' and snapshot.ok==true and type(snapshot.uiScale)=='number' and type(authority)=='number'
  and math.abs(snapshot.uiScale-value)<.001 and math.abs(authority-value)<.001
end
local function setScale(value)
 local response=a:Invoke('SetSettings',{uiScale=value})
 assert(type(response)=='table' and response.ok==true,'ordinary Settings request failed')
 local deadline=os.clock()+6 local stable
 repeat
  local now=os.clock()
  if observeScale(value) then stable=stable or now else stable=nil end
  if stable and now-stable>=.3 then return end
  assert(now<deadline,'authoritative Shop UI scale did not settle: '..tostring(value))
  task.wait(.05)
 until false
end
local function inside(a,b)
 local p,s,q,t=a.AbsolutePosition,a.AbsoluteSize,b.AbsolutePosition,b.AbsoluteSize
 return p.X>=q.X-1 and p.Y>=q.Y-1 and p.X+s.X<=q.X+t.X+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=q.Y+t.Y+1
end
local samples={} local fail
local ok,err=pcall(function()
 for _,scale in ipairs({.8,1,1.2})do
  setScale(scale)
  for _,page in ipairs({'Fists','Premium','Boosts','Honor','Robux'})do
   a:Invoke('OpenShopPage',page) task.wait(.25)
   local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local issues={} local count=0 local minTarget=math.huge
   local function issue(text) if #issues<6 then issues[#issues+1]=text end end
   if not observeScale(scale) then issue('authoritative scale changed') end
   if not inside(g.GameMenu,g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD) then issue('modal escaped safe area') end
   for _,x in ipairs(s:GetDescendants())do
    if (x:IsA('TextLabel') or x:IsA('TextButton')) and x.Visible and not x.TextFits then issue(x.Parent.Name..'.'..x.Name..' TextFits=false') end
    if x:IsA('Frame') and x.Name:match('ShopCard$')then
     count+=1
     for _,name in ipairs({'Name','Rarity','Detail','Price'})do
      local label=x:FindFirstChild(name)
      if not label or not inside(label,x) then issue(x.Name..'.'..name..' escaped card') end
     end
     local action=x:FindFirstChild(x.Name:gsub('ShopCard$','Action'))
     if not action or not inside(action,x) then issue(x.Name..'.Action escaped card') else minTarget=math.min(minTarget,action.AbsoluteSize.X,action.AbsoluteSize.Y) end
     if s:GetAttribute('ShopCompactLayout')=='DesktopReadableRowsV1' then
      local nameLimit=x.Name and x:FindFirstChild('Name'):FindFirstChildOfClass('UITextSizeConstraint')
      local priceLimit=x:FindFirstChild('Price'):FindFirstChildOfClass('UITextSizeConstraint')
      if not nameLimit or nameLimit.MinTextSize<14 or not priceLimit or priceLimit.MinTextSize<14 or x.Rarity.TextSize<12 or x.Detail.TextSize<12 or action.TextSize<14 then issue(x.Name..' font floor') end
      if page=='Premium' and (not string.find(x.Detail.Text,'Power',1,true) or not string.find(x.Detail.Text,'Luck',1,true)) then issue(x.Name..' incomplete Premium benefits') end
     end
    end
   end
   if minTarget<44 then issue('target below44: '..tostring(minTarget)) end
   local expected=page=='Fists' and 16 or page=='Premium' and 3 or page=='Boosts' and 2 or 4
   if count~=expected then issue('catalog count '..count..' expected '..expected) end
   local sample={scale=scale,page=page,layout=s:GetAttribute('ShopCompactLayout'),cards=count,minTarget=minTarget}
   samples[#samples+1]=sample
   if #issues>0 then fail={sample=sample,issues=issues,viewport={workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X,workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y},menu={g.GameMenu.AbsoluteSize.X,g.GameMenu.AbsoluteSize.Y}} return end
  end
 end
end)
local restored,restoreError=pcall(setScale,saved)
local result={ok=ok and not fail and #samples==15 and restored,samples=samples,failed=fail,restored=restored,error=not ok and tostring(err):sub(1,400) or nil,restoreError=not restored and tostring(restoreError):sub(1,200) or nil}
return H:JSONEncode(result)
